about: Shows that work is running when there is no progress to report. Where the work reports how far along it is, show a progress indicator instead. The spinner has no role and no text, so write the words the wait needs beside it and set `aria-busy` on the region that is waiting.

button.about: A spinner at `inherit` in a disabled button, in three looks. With the palette at `current`, the arc takes the button's label ink in each one.
button.title: In a button

effect.about: A halo in the palette's solid at half opacity: `glow` holds still and `pulse` breathes. Both stop moving when the reader prefers reduced motion.
effect.title: Effects

inline.about: At `inherit` the spinner is as tall as the text it sits in, so the line keeps its height at every text size.
inline.title: In a line of text

palette.about: The arc in each semantic palette's solid color. The theme engine keeps every solid at 3:1 or more against the page. `current` takes the ink of the surrounding text.
palette.title: Palettes

size.about: Every step of the icon scale, and `inherit`, which takes the height of the surrounding text.
size.title: Sizes

stroke.about: The theme's three stroke widths, and `heavy` for a thicker ring. The stroke is a border width, so it keeps its weight at every size.
stroke.title: Strokes

title: Spinner

track.about: The ring behind the arc, in the palette's muted color.
track.title: Track
